name: The Purple Wall, Lulung Aranya Nivas
signature_dish: Buffet meals with local Odia delicacies, overlooking the Simlipal hills
why_it_matters: The Purple Wall is the multi-cuisine restaurant of Lulung Aranya Nivas, the main resort at the Lulung gateway to Simlipal Tiger Reserve. It serves buffet breakfast and à la carte lunch and dinner — North Indian, South Indian and Chinese alongside local Odia delicacies — from a 34-seat dining room with a deck overlooking the forested hills. It is the most comfortable sit-down dining at the edge of the reserve.
insider_tip: This is at Lulung, just outside the park gate — the practical base for meals since dining deep inside the core is limited to forest rest houses. Ask the kitchen for the local Odia dishes rather than defaulting to the pan-Indian buffet. Non-residents can usually dine; check ahead in peak season.
signature_address: Lulung Aranya Nivas Resort, Lulung, Simlipal, Mayurbhanj district, Odisha 757002

name: Kumari Nature Camp Kitchen
signature_dish: Community-cooked local cuisine at a Santali-cottage forest camp
why_it_matters: Kumari is one of the Forest Department nature camps inside Simlipal, set in a valley with traditional Santali and bamboo cottages. Like the other interior camps, it has its own catering — community members cook and serve local cuisine, both veg and non-veg, with all meals included in the camp tariff. Inside the reserve, the camp kitchens are the only food option.
insider_tip: There are no restaurants inside Simlipal — eating means staying at a forest camp, and the booking covers all meals. Book online only via similipal.org or ecotourodisha.com. The core area is closed roughly June to October, so plan a winter visit. Carry water and snacks for safari hours.
signature_address: Kumari Nature Camp, Simlipal Tiger Reserve, Mayurbhanj district, Odisha 757091

name: Gurguria Nature Camp Kitchen
signature_dish: Catered Odia meals at a pine-forest eco-camp with an orchidarium
why_it_matters: Gurguria Nature Camp lies amid jungle and pine forest inside Simlipal, with Santali and luxury cottages and an orchidarium of about 70 indigenous orchids. It has catering facilities like the other interior camps, with community-cooked veg and non-veg local food included in the stay tariff — one of the handful of places to eat within the reserve.
insider_tip: Meals are part of the camp booking; there is no walk-in dining anywhere in the core. Reserve through the official Simlipal or Odisha eco-tourism portal well ahead, as camp capacity is small. Visit in winter — the core zone shuts during the monsoon months.
signature_address: Gurguria Nature Camp, Simlipal Tiger Reserve, Mayurbhanj district, Odisha 757091
